lore: Wraeclast remembers every sin you dare to repeat.
Exile, the shore was mercy. This is not.
The gods have stopped listening. Fate has not.
Maps fade, monuments crumble, legends reroll.
Some destinies are forged in blood; others in chance.
Kaom had a plan. You have a roll.
Karui drums, Eternal banners, one long scream.
Innocence burned, Sin smiled, and the world kept turning.
The Ancients whisper; the Randomancer answers.
Every shard of corruption hides an opportunity.
Not all experiments survive their creators.
You brought flasks and hope. Leave with stories.
The land is cruel. Your build can be crueler.
When the dead won’t stay down, neither should your ideas.
meta: Meta got you down? Wraeclast has other plans.
Good builds farm maps. Great builds generate stories.
Balance passes are temporary. terrible ideas are eternal.
If the forums hate it, you’re probably onto something.
The best loot is the friends confused along the way.
May your flasks be full and your expectations low.
When in doubt, blame desync. When inspired, blame this roll.
Warning: contents may include joy, regret, or both.

subtitles: Conjure the impossible. Defy the meta.
Fate is just another loot table.
Reckless by design, ruthless by accident.
Because ‘viable’ is such a boring word.
The meta is a suggestion, not a sentence.
Leave the comfort zone in Oriath.
For when respeccing once just isn’t enough.

fallback: Steel, instinct, and strange conviction carry the day.
Power takes many shapes; survival favors the bold.
Every road narrows to the moment of decision.
Some paths are walked. Others are carved.

Warrior: Steel bends before the will that swings it.
Every scar is proof that standing ground is a weapon.
Strength speaks plainly, and the battlefield listens.
Mercenary: Every problem has a price, a distance, and a clean solution.
Cold judgment travels faster than hesitation.
Survival belongs to whoever controls the next heartbeat.
Ranger: The horizon is measured in heartbeats and distance.
She moves where the wind leaves room and strikes where it does not.
Distance is not safety. It is an invitation.
Huntress: She reads the ground like scripture and answers without hesitation.
Instinct sharpens where hesitation goes to die.
The quarry always learns too late which of them was being hunted.
Witch: The dark yields secrets to those willing to pay for them.
She speaks softly to powers that should have stayed unnamed.
Death, blood, and shadow are merely different kinds of leverage.
Sorceress: Flame, frost, and storm gather at a gesture.
The air changes its mind when she raises a hand.
She turns raw elements into precise catastrophe.
Monk: Stillness gathers force until motion becomes inevitable.
Discipline makes a weapon of every breath.
Each strike begins long before the body moves.
Druid: The wild answers in fang, storm, root, and flame.
Bone and bark remember older shapes.
Nature does not ask permission before it changes.

Titan: The earth yields first; everything else follows.
Each step carries the promise of an impact yet to come.
Armour turns aside blows. Mass turns aside armies.
He does not weather the battle; the battle breaks around him.
Strength becomes something geological in his hands.
Warbringer: One roar is enough to turn fear into momentum.
The battlefield answers when his voice becomes a weapon.
Old voices gather behind every challenge he bellows.
He calls for violence, and violence arrives in ranks.
Even silence feels like the breath before his next command.
Smith of Kitava: The forge does not end at the anvil; it follows him into battle.
Every weapon is unfinished until it has tasted war.
Heat, iron, and intent are hammered into the same shape.
Steel remembers the hand that gave it purpose.
What he forges does not always stay still.
Tactician: Every battlefield has a shape, and he decides where it breaks.
One signal moves a dozen dangers into place.
Victory begins with choosing where the enemy is allowed to stand.
He turns preparation into pressure and pressure into surrender.
Nothing is improvised except the enemy's retreat.
Witchhunter: Magic is only dangerous until someone learns where to strike.
He hunts the unnatural with the patience of a held breath.
Every spell leaves an opening; he has made a profession of finding it.
Superstition ends where his certainty begins.
The stranger the threat, the steadier his hand.
Gemling Legionnaire: Jewelled power glows beneath skin trained to endure it.
His body is an arsenal written in light.
Every gift of power finds somewhere new to take root.
Flesh adapts, hardens, and makes room for one more impossible talent.
He wears versatility as others wear armour.
Deadeye: The horizon narrows to a single point.
Distance only gives intent more time to become inevitable.
The wind carries every strike along the path she chose.
She leaves the enemy no safe angle to stand in.
By the time the attack is noticed, the decision was made long ago.
Pathfinder: Every vial is a promise with uncertain consequences.
Poison, remedy, and opportunity differ only by dosage.
She carries a travelling laboratory and no shortage of volunteers.
One measured draught turns endurance into momentum.
Where others see a toxin, she sees a tool waiting for refinement.
Amazon: Her attack lands where instinct and precision agree.
She closes distance with the grace of a hunting bird.
Every motion is measured, every opening earned.
Speed sharpens strength into something finer than brute force.
The duel is decided in the instant before her opponent commits.
Ritualist: Blood marks the boundary; something unseen answers from beyond it.
Every offering leaves the circle emptier and the silence less alone.
She turns sacrifice into a language the dead still understand.
Pain is never wasted when it can be given purpose.
The ritual ends only when every debt has found a body.
Blood Mage: Every heartbeat is both weapon and price.
Blood leaves the body only to return as power.
She spends life with the confidence of someone certain more can be taken.
Pain becomes precise when guided by practiced hands.
Her strongest incantations begin beneath the ribs.
Lich: Death is less an ending than a discipline.
Cold patience settles where mortal urgency once lived.
She trades warmth for power and finds the bargain favorable.
Decay gathers close, obedient and unhurried.
Her shadow lingers a little longer than the body that cast it.
Infernalist: Fire answers hunger with hunger of its own.
Something monstrous waits just beneath the skin.
She makes bargains in heat, ash, and breath.
Flames gather around her as though recognizing their kin.
Every transformation leaves less room for mercy.
Abyssal Lich: The dark beneath death has begun to answer her.
Souls gather where servants once stood, stripped down to pure purpose.
She has learned that even undeath casts a deeper shadow.
Curses linger long after mercy would have ended them.
Something bottomless looks through her eyes and finds the world insufficient.
Chronomancer: She steps aside from moments that would have killed her.
Time loosens when she refuses to accept its first answer.
Seconds fold, repeat, and vanish at her command.
Every mistake is merely a future she has not kept.
The battle ends once she reaches the version where she wins.
Stormweaver: Lightning and frost meet in the air before choosing a victim.
She braids thunder through cold until the sky itself shudders.
Storms do not follow her; they gather around her.
Every spark seeks another path, and she provides one.
The battlefield becomes weather with intent.
Disciple of Varashta: At a word, bound spirits rise from silence to fulfill their debt.
She does not cast alone; every command wakes another oath.
Invisible servants wait in stillness until duty calls.
Fire, water, and shadow answer from vessels kept close at hand.
Her authority is quiet; the powers bound to it are not.
Invoker: Elemental force gathers at the end of every practiced motion.
Each strike invites another current into the body.
Fire, frost, and lightning become forms of discipline.
He moves through violence as though completing a familiar sequence.
Power accumulates where breath, balance, and impact meet.
Acolyte of Chayula: Darkness gathers around him like a second discipline.
He finds strength in the places light refuses to enter.
Chaos is not disorder when the mind holding it is still.
Shadow becomes shelter before it becomes a weapon.
He walks calmly beside powers that would unmake a lesser will.
Shaman: Fang, claw, storm, and stone answer the same ancient rhythm.
Every transformation reveals a truth the human shape could not hold.
He carries the weather in his breath and the wild in his bones.
Power rises from earth, blood, and instinct together.
The beast within is not a loss of control, but another kind of mastery.
Oracle: He has already seen the moment when this choice succeeds.
Possible futures crowd close, waiting to be made real.
Chance loses some of its mystery beneath his gaze.
He walks paths that exist only because he knows where they lead.
The present is merely the future he has decided to keep.
